AgentScribe ships with plugins for:\n35\t//! - **Claude Code** (`claude-code.toml`) - JSONL format with session metadata files\n36\t//! - **Aider** (`aider.toml`) - Markdown format with delimiter-based session detection\n37\t//! - **OpenCode** (`opencode.toml`) - SQLite format with JSON tree extraction\n38\t//! - **Codex** (`codex.toml`) - JSONL format with envelope unwrapping\n39\t//! - **Cursor** (`cursor.toml`) - SQLite format with KV store extraction\n40\t//! - **Windsurf** (`windsurf.toml`) - SQLite format similar to Cursor\n41\t//!\n42\t//! # Custom Plugins\n43\t//!\n44\t//! Users can add custom plugins by dropping TOML files in `~/.agentscribe/plugins/`.\n45\t//! See `plugins/BUILDING_PLUGINS.md` for the complete plugin authoring guide.\n46\t//!\n47\t//! # Validation\n48\t//!\n49\t//! Plugins are validated at load time for:\n50\t//! - Required fields (name, version, paths, format)\n51\t//! - Valid format values (jsonl, markdown, json-tree, sqlite, json-array)\n52\t//! - Valid session detection methods for the chosen format\n53\t//! - Valid envelope routing actions (event, meta, skip)\n54\t//! - Path expansion and accessibility\n55\t//!\n56\t//! Invalid plugins are skipped with a warning rather than blocking the entire scrape.\n57\t\n58\tuse crate::error::{AgentScribeError, Result};\n59\tuse serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};\n60\tuse std::collections::HashMap;\n61\tuse std::path::{Path, PathBuf};\n62\tuse tracing::warn;\n63\t\n64\t/// Complete plugin definition loaded from TOML.\n65\t///\n66\t/// A [`Plugin`] contains all configuration needed to scrape one agent type. Invalid plugins (missing required fields, invalid\n82\t/// format values, malformed paths) are skipped with a warning rather than blocking scraping.\n83\t///\n84\t/// # Examples\n85\t///\n86\t/// ```toml\n87\t/// [plugin]\n88\t/// name = \"claude-code\"\n89\t/// version = \"1.0\"\n90\t///\n91\t/// [source]\n92\t/// paths = [\"~/.claude/projects/**/*.jsonl\"]\n93\t/// format = \"jsonl\"\n94\t///\n95\t/// [parser]\n96\t/// timestamp = \"timestamp\"\n97\t/// role = \"message.role\"\n98\t/// content = \"message.content\"\n99\t/// ```\n100\t#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\n101\tpub struct Plugin {\n102\t    /// Plugin identity (name and version)\n103\t    pub plugin: PluginMeta,\n104\t\n105\t    /// Log source configuration (paths, format, session detection)\n106\t    pub source: Source,\n107\t\n108\t    /// Field mapping and parsing configuration\n109\t    #[serde(default)]\n110\t    pub parser: Parser,\n111\t\n112\t    /// Optional metadata extraction configuration\n113\t    #[serde(default)]\n114\t    pub metadata: Option<Metadata>,\n115\t}\n116\t\n117\t/// Plugin identity metadata.\n118\t///\n119\t/// Stores the plugin's name and version for display, validation, and compatibility checking.\n120\t/// The version field is not currently used for compatibility enforcement, but provides a\n121\t/// mechanism for future plugin evolution.\n122\t#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\n123\tpub struct PluginMeta {\n124\t    /// Unique plugin identifier (e.g., \"claude-code\", \"aider\", \"opencode\")\n125\t    ///\n126\t    /// Used as the `source_agent` value in canonical events and for plugin selection\n127\t    /// via CLI flags (`--agent claude-code`).\n128\t    pub name: String,\n129\t\n130\t    /// Plugin version string (e.g., \"1.0\", \"2.1.3\")\n131\t    ///\n132\t    /// Currently informational only. sources\n138\t#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, Serialize, Deserialize)]\n139\tpub struct JsonArraySourceConfig {\n140\t    /// Dot-path to the array within the JSON document (e.g., \"data.items\")\n141\t    /// Empty string means the document root is the array\n142\t    #[serde(default)]\n143\t    pub items_path: String,\n144\t}\n145\t\n146\t/// Envelope configuration for JSONL sources where lines are wrapped\n147\t/// in a {timestamp, type, payload} structure (e.g., Codex rollouts)\n148\t#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\n149\tpub struct Envelope {\n150\t /// Get the routing action for a given type value\n161\t    /// Returns \"skip\" for unknown types (with warning logged at parse time)\n162\t    pub fn get_routing(&self, type_value: &str) -> &str {\n163\t        match self.type_routing.get(type_value) {\n164\t            Some(action) => {\n165\t                match action.as_str() {\n166\t                    \"event\" | \"meta\" | \"skip\" => action,\n167\t                    // Invalid routing values are treated as skip\n168\t                    _ => \"skip\",\n169\t                }\n170\t            }\n171\t            // Unknown types routing to 'skip'\"\n176\t                );\n177\t                \"skip\"\n178\t            }\n179\t        }\n180\t    }\n181\t\n182\t    /// Validate envelope configuration\n183\t    pub fn \"meta\" | \"skip\") {\n187\t                return Err(AgentScribeError::InvalidPlugin(format!(\n188\t                    \"Invalid envelope routing action '{}' for type '{}': must be one of 'event', conversation logs in a different format. [`LogFormat`] specifies which\n225\t/// parser to use for a given plugin. The format determines:\n226\t///\n227\t/// - How the file is read (streaming vs. random access)\n228\t/// - How sessions are detected (one-file-per-session vs. delimiters vs. queries)\n229\t/// - What fields are available for mapping\n230\t/// - Whether incremental scraping is supported\n231\t///\n232\t/// # Format Variants\n233\t///\n234\t/// ## Jsonl\n235\t/// **Best for**: Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode (legacy), Pi, Goose\n236\t///\n237\t/// JSONL (JSON Lines) format: one JSON object per line. Supports incremental scraping via\n238\t/// byte offset tracking. Each line can represent an event, session metadata, or noise.\n239\t/// Requires envelope unwrapping for formats like Codex where lines are wrapped in\n240\t/// `{timestamp, type, payload}` structures.\n241\t///\n242\t/// ## Markdown\n243\t/// **Best for**: Aider\n244\t///\n245\t/// Plain text Markdown with delimiter-based session detection. Sessions are separated by\n246\t/// marker lines (e.g., `# aider chat started at YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`). Incremental\n247\t/// scraping tracks the last delimiter position to handle partially-written sessions.\n248\t///\n249\t/// ## JsonTree\n250\t/// **Best for**: OpenCode (current), some legacy Codex formats\n251\t///\n252\t/// Hierarchical JSON files where sessions, messages, and parts are stored in separate\n253\t/// files or database tables. Requires tree traversal and re-assembly to extract events\n254\t/// in conversation order.\n255\t///\n256\t/// ## Sqlite\n257\t/// **Best for**: Cursor, Windsurf\n258\t///\n259\t/// SQLite databases where sessions and messages are stored in tables. Requires SQL\n260\t/// queries with row ordering to extract events. Supports incremental scraping via\n261\t/// time-based filtering (`time_updated > last_scraped`).\n262\t///\n263\t/// ## JsonArray\n264\t/// **Best for**: Gemini CLI\n265\t///\n266\t/// Single JSON file containing an array of message objects. The entire file is read\n267\t/// into memory and parsed as an array. Does not support incremental scraping via byte\n268\t/// offsets (the array is rewritten in place), so falls back to mtime-based full rescans.\n269\t///\n270\t/// # Choosing a Format\n271\t///\n272\t/// When authoring custom plugins, choose the format that matches the agent's native storage:\n273\t///\n274\t/// - Agent writes line-by-line to a file → `Jsonl` (most common)\n275\t/// - Agent appends to a text file with separators → `Markdown`\n276\t/// - Agent stores conversations in a database → `Sqlite`\n277\t/// - Agent writes complete arrays in one file → `JsonArray`\n278\t/// - Agent uses complex nested JSON structures → `JsonTree`\n279\t#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]\n280\t#[serde(rename_all = \"kebab-case\")]\n281\tpub enum LogFormat {\n282\t    /// JSON Lines format (one JSON object per line)\n283\t    Jsonl,\n284\t\n285\t    /// Plain text Markdown with delimiter-based session detection\n286\t    Markdown,\n287\t\n288\t    /// Hierarchical JSON structures requiring tree traversal\n289\t    JsonTree,\n290\t\n291\t    /// SQLite database with query-based session extraction\n292\t    Sqlite,\n293\t\n294\t    /// Single JSON file containing an array of objects\n295\t    JsonArray,\n296\t}\n297\t\n298\timpl LogFormat {\n299\t    pub fn as_str(&self) -> &'static str {\n300\t        match self {\n301\t            LogFormat::Jsonl => \"jsonl\",\n302\t            LogFormat::Markdown => \"markdown\",\n303\t            LogFormat::JsonTree => \"json-tree\",\n304\t            LogFormat::Sqlite => \"sqlite\",\n305\t            LogFormat::JsonArray => \"json-array\",\n306\t        }\n307\t    }\n308\t\n309\t    #[allow(dead_code, clippy::should_implement_trait)]\n310\t    pub fn from_str(s: &str) -> Option<Self> {\n311\t        match s {\n312\t            \"jsonl\" => Some(LogFormat::Jsonl),\n313\t            \"markdown\" => Some(LogFormat::Markdown),\n314\t            \"json-tree\" => Some(LogFormat::JsonTree),\n315\t            \"sqlite\" => Some(LogFormat::Sqlite),\n316\t            \"json-array\" => Some(LogFormat::JsonArray),\n317\t            _ => None,\n318\t        }\n319\t    }\n320\t}\n321\t\n322\t/// Session detection strategy\n323\t#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, }\n518\t    }\n519\t\n520\t    /// Load all plugins from the plugin directory\n521\t    pub fn load_all(&mut self) -> Result<Vec<String>> {\n522\t        if !self.plugin_dir.exists() {\n523\t AgentScribe ships with plugins for:\n//! - **Claude Code** (`claude-code.toml`) - JSONL format with session metadata files\n//! - **Aider** (`aider.toml`) - Markdown format with delimiter-based session detection\n//! - **OpenCode** (`opencode.toml`) - SQLite format with JSON tree extraction\n//! - **Codex** (`codex.toml`) - JSONL format with envelope unwrapping\n//! - **Cursor** (`cursor.toml`) - SQLite format with KV store extraction\n//! - **Windsurf** (`windsurf.toml`) - SQLite format similar to Cursor\n//!\n//! # Custom Plugins\n//!\n//! Plugins are validated at load time for:\n//! - Required fields (name, version, paths, format)\n//! - Valid format values (jsonl, markdown, json-tree, sqlite, json-array)\n//! - Valid session detection methods for the chosen format\n//! - Valid envelope routing actions (event, meta, skip)\n//! - Path expansion and accessibility\n//!\n//!
